## Changes

### New
- Mihon / Tachiyomi extensions (Android 9+). Add a Mihon extension repo in More → Extensions → Extension repos (its `index.min.json`, `repo.json` or base URL) and install its extensions right in the app, with no separate APK install. They work like the app's own sources: browse, search and filters, the comic page, the reader, bookmarks, refresh, history and downloads. Extensions update from their repo, and one only loads when it is signed with the key the repo publishes.
- Mihon extension settings: an extension with settings (a mirror, image quality, content rating…) has a Settings button in Extensions.
- A scanlator picker on the comic page when a Mihon comic has several groups: pick whose version of each chapter shows.
- Importing a Mihon / Tachiyomi backup matches Mihon extensions exactly, and you can install a missing one from the import screen. Comics an app extension can't read go to the Mihon one instead of being left out.
- Extensions: icons, a red 18+ label (18+ extensions are hidden until you turn off Hide 18+), search by name or site, and a language picker with every language's name and count.
- The update sheet shows the release notes formatted.

### Smoother
- A comic opens with its details right away while a slow chapter list is still loading, and opening it again only reads new chapters.
- Mihon chapter downloads keep going in the background, like the others.
- Long filter lists fold away behind "Show all", and a sort with an ascending and descending order is one chip per field: tap it again to turn the direction.
- Headers stay put on Extensions, Downloads and the Migration screens.
- The comic page shows the chapter count, release year and status only when the source knows them; the rating sits next to the source.
- Cards leave out an empty chapter line.

### Fixes
- Genre chips on the comic page only open Explore when the source can filter by that genre.
- Bundled extensions show their repo icon.
